name: SDF Scaling and Early Ray Termination for Fast Sphere Tracing
definition: A two-pass rendering method that improves sphere tracing performance and reduces artifacts by using a single low-resolution buffer to provide a head start for full-resolution rays, combined with SDF scaling and early ray termination.
summary: This two-pass method accelerates sphere tracing by using low-resolution SDF scaling and early termination to generate a coarse distance buffer that initializes full-resolution rays closer to surfaces.
